Title: NETMESSAGE:Nih (radio):\nHQ, we found it.\nThe military has been using the trains to transport the missiles.
Translation: Nih（无线电）：\n总部，我们找到了。\n军方一直在用火车运输导弹。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):
Copy that, Chap squad leader.
The next objective will be cutting their communications and sabotaging their missile systems.
Take the commandos to the Central Security Station located nearby the launch ramps.
Translation:
Sven Viking（无线电）：
收到，Chap小队队长。
下一个目标是切断他们的通信并破坏他们的导弹系统。
带领突击队前往发射坡道附近的中央安全站。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Sniper (radio):
Roger that, HQ.
Amckern, dismantle the train and the missiles with Bug squad. Then block the tracks.
Func_Squad, transport the commandos.
Translation:
Sniper（无线电）：
明白，总部。
Amckern，和Bug小队一起拆除火车和导弹。然后封锁铁轨。
Func_Squad，运送突击队。
